# Cncf Trivy Reviewer

Review Trivy using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Trivy is an all-in-one security scanner that beings vulnerability, SBOM, misconfigurations, leaked secrets, and license scanning together, across container images, code repositories, Kubernetes clusters and more.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
